text:
Airport Cargo Area
Six residential units are yet to relocate, some of which have replacement housing but are awaiting occupancy.
Lapham Street
There are 8 individuals or families remaining on this project. It is anticipated that these people will not constitute a problem and the project is proceeding on schedule per the acquiring agency.
PROPOSED PROJECTS
Lake Freeway
Originally these project segments were to displace approximately 349 invididuals or families. Actual displacement however will not occur within the time period of displacement for the subject project due to various requirements yet to be met, namely, environmental statements and development of a housing program.
Stadium Freeway
Approximately 97 families are believed to be potentially affected in this project area. These displaces, as those on the Lake Freeway, will not be required to move during the period of displacement on this project.
Maitland Park
This park project will involve 3 families but will be acquired at a later date, yet to be established.
Belt Freeway
This project is in preliminary planning with no acquisition, except hardship cases, planned until possibly 1975.
Airport Clear Zone
The County announced recently a proposal for future expansion of Mitchell Field. This proposal is for acquisition of 12 acres in 1972 and another 12 acres in 1973 for a clear zone on the north side of the Airport.
